5.eng-name: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: Rapporté par ‘Ubaidullah bin ‘Abdullah : ‘Umar sortit le jour de l’Aïd et envoya demander à Abu Waqid Al-Laithi ce que le Prophète ﷺ récitait ce jour-là. Il répondit : “Qaf” [Qaf (50)] et “Iqtarabat” [Al-Qamar]

chapter.ara-name: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ
chapter.eng-name: What was narrated concerning the recitation in the ‘Eid Prayers
